entries.descriptionOriginal: Welcome to the tropical resort Laguna ! Extremely detailed luxury map , made out of hobby for design! designed mostly for Deathmatch & Classic 🌴 LAGUNA – LUXURY RESORT Welcome to LAGUNA, an exclusive five-star island resort surrounded by crystal-clear waters, pools, golden sandy beaches, and lush tropical landscapes. A destination designed for luxury, relaxation, and unforgettable experiences. 🏝️ THE LOCATION The resort features a luxurious beachfront hotel in Maldives, an elegant swimming pool, relaxing beach areas, tropical gardens, beautiful fountains, and a spectacular underwater aquarium tunnel. Visitors can enjoy the sunshine, explore the surroundings, and experience the atmosphere of a world-class holiday destination. 2 bombs on both sides of the resort. 🔴 TERRORISTS (T) Your objective is to infiltrate the luxury resort and carry out your mission. Navigate through the resort's facilities, use the surrounding environment to your advantage, and coordinate with your teammates to overcome the opposing force. 🔵 COUNTER-TERRORISTS (CT) Your mission is to protect the resort, secure its facilities, and prevent the opposing team from completing their objectives. Work together, maintain control of strategic areas, and defend the resort against any threats. ✨ YOUR EXPERIENCE Whether you're fighting through the resort's luxurious interiors, exploring its tropical outdoor areas, or enjoying the beautiful beachfront scenery, Tropical Paradise offers a unique combination of competitive gameplay and a relaxing vacation atmosphere. 🌊 A paradise for tourists. A battlefield for professionals. Enjoy your stay! Based on first map Laguava Credits: 1- Resting beds - Poseidon 2- Few props from Zoo 3- Few props from Resort 4- Few props from jb_san_palmora and sand texture Thanks for their help to light up the map!

entries.descriptionOriginal: Port (L4D2) — Competitive version Left 4 Dead 2's "The Port", rebuilt in Counter-Strike 2 as a bomb defusal map. This is the port from Left 4 Dead 2, the finale setting of the The Passing and The Sacrifice campaigns, brought to CS2 with its original geometry, textures and models. This is the competitive version, reworked for balanced 5v5 play. Features Bomb defusal with two bombsites (A and B). T and CT spawns placed so neither team has an advantage. Blocked-off areas so nobody gets extra height or routes: the bridge and the safe rooms of The Passing and The Sacrifice are not accessible. Light fog only at the map edges: it doesn't get in the way of long-range visibility. Custom official-style radar with callouts on the minimap (T Start, Middle, A Ramp, Boat Bar…). Bot navmesh and Deathmatch spawns. Works in Competitive, Casual and Deathmatch. Competitive vs. full version The map comes in two versions. This is the competitive one, made for balanced matches. The full version is made for exploring and enjoying the map, closer to Left 4 Dead 2: Competitive: bridge and safe rooms closed · light fog only at the edges · static elevator in The Passing · balanced spawns. Full: access to the bridge and to The Passing and The Sacrifice safe rooms · dense Left 4 Dead 2-style fog covering almost the whole map · working elevator. Credits Original map, textures and models: Valve (Left 4 Dead 2). Fan-made port, not affiliated with Valve. Port (L4D2) — Versión competitiva El mapa "The Port" de Left 4 Dead 2, convertido a Counter-Strike 2 como mapa de desactivación de bomba. Este es el puerto de Left 4 Dead 2, el escenario final de las campañas The Passing y The Sacrifice, llevado a CS2 con su geometría, sus texturas y sus modelos originales. Esta es la versión competitiva: adaptada para jugar 5 contra 5 de forma equilibrada. Características Modo desactivación de bomba con dos emplazamientos (A y B). Spawns de T y AT colocados para que ningún equipo tenga ventaja. Zonas cerradas para que nadie gane altura ni rutas de más: el puente y los refugios de The Passing y The Sacrifice no son accesibles. Niebla ligera solo en los bordes del mapa: no estorba la visibilidad a larga distancia. Radar propio al estilo de los mapas oficiales y nombres de zona en el minimapa (Base T, Medio, Rampa A, Bar del puerto…). Navmesh para bots y spawns de Deathmatch. Funciona en Competitivo, Casual y Deathmatch. Versión competitiva vs. versión completa El mapa tiene dos versiones. Esta es la competitiva, pensada para partidas equilibradas. La versión completa está pensada para recorrer y disfrutar el mapa, más parecida a Left 4 Dead 2: Competitiva: puente y refugios cerrados · niebla ligera solo en los bordes · ascensor de The Passing fijo · spawns equilibrados. Completa: acceso al puente y a los refugios de The Passing y The Sacrifice · niebla densa como la de Left 4 Dead 2, que cubre casi todo el mapa · ascensor funcional. Créditos Mapa original, texturas y modelos: Valve (Left 4 Dead 2). Este es un port hecho por fans, sin relación oficial con Valve.
